jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Semi Senior - Analista de datos especialista en...
jobs_results.description:
Position Summary : The Data Analyst II will work with a variety of software applications to

ensure our company development timelines are met and daily issues are resolved properly.

They will work closely with the EDI Development and Operational Teams in carrying out the

goal of meeting timely release schedules while maintaining the quality control required to

effectively meet the business needs of the company.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

Daily support and maintenance of existing EDI integrations, providing support to all EDI

production processes.

Maintain all documents applications testing and scripting.

Collaborate on data research and business intelligence projects.

Coordinate and ensure all testing requirements are fulfilled.

Strong communication skills including the ability to communicate to all levels of

personnel.

Document business requirements and revise existing system and user documentation as

needed.

Research and resolve internal system issues... related to EDI transactions and related

applications.

Responds to requests accurately and in a timely manner.

Responsible for documenting EDI testing processes and assisting with EDI applications

testing training documentation.

Maintaining existing system and user documentation and application release

documentation as needed.

Utilization of SharePoint for team documentation.

Preparation of metrics and reports as needed.

Prepare and maintain test data and perform various tests on EDI processes.

Prepare required documents and evaluate reports and design daily logs.

Document failed translation processes.

EDI Help desk triage-research and resolve internal system issues related to EDI

transactions, application and processes utilizing ticketing system.

Work with the EDI Managers, EDI Coordinators, Analysts and Database Administrators in

the deployment of applications.

Accurate and timely responses for internal customers.

Ensuring data is accurate and complete for loading.

Engage on process improvements for resource utilization tracking.

Perform system data audits upon demand.

Participate in systems testing and analysis of data and processes.

Recommend improvements to same and manage communication with internal

stakeholders and ensure compliance to all policies and procedures.

Coordinate with EDI trading partners to resolve all production issues and perform

transaction tests and resolve all EDI issues according to specification and maintain all

transaction sets appropriately.

Must be an aggressive and self-motivated individual with proficiencies in internal client

relations.

Perform other work-related duties as assigned.

BúsquedasIT

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst / Salesforce CRM Analytics
jobs_results.description:
Descripción de la empresa

Devoteam es una consultora europea líder enfocada en estrategia digital, plataformas tecnológicas, ciberseguridad y transformación empresarial a través de la tecnología. Centrada en 6 áreas de especialización, abordamos los desafíos estratégicos de nuestros clientes: Digital Business & Products, Data-driven Intelligence, Distributed Cloud, Business Automation, Ciberseguridad y la Sostenibilidad conseguida por la Digitalización.

La Tecnología está en nuestro ADN y creemos en ella como una palanca capaz de impulsar el cambio para mejorar, manteniendo un equilibrio que nos permite ofrecer a nuestros clientes herramientas tecnológicas de primer nivel pero siempre con la cercanía y profesionalidad de un equipo que actúa como guía durante el camino.

Nuestros 25 años de experiencia nos convierten en una consultora innovadora, consolidada y madura que permite el desarrollo de nuestras 10.000 personas, certificando continuamente a nuestros consultores en las... últimas tecnologías y contando con expertos en: Cloud, BI, Data Analytics, Excelencia en Procesos de Negocio, Gestión de la Relación con clientes, Ciberseguridad, Marketing Digital, Machine Learning, Ingeniería y desarrollo del Software.

Devoteam ha sido premiado como Partner del año 2021 de los 5 líderes de la nube: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, Salesforce y ServiceNow.

#CreativeTechForBetterChange

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos incorporar en nuestra unidad de Salesforce un Data Analyst con experiencia en Salesforce CRM Analytics.

Requisitos mínimos:
• 2 años de experiencia trabajando con CRM Analytics (o 1 año de experiencia con CRM Analytics y +2 años de experiencia con otras herramientas de BI como PowerBI, Tableau o Qlik).
• 2 años de experiencia trabajando con Salesforce (Sales/Service).
• Conocimiento de Einstein Discovery y los diferentes productos de Einstein dentro de Salesforce (Next Best Action, Insights, Recommendations, Case Classification, Bots, etc...)

Requisitos deseados:
• Conocimiento de ETLs (InformaticaCloud, PowerCenter, Talend).
• Conocimiento de datalakes (Snowflake, Azure, AWS).
• Conocimiento de Data Cloud / CDP.

Qué ofrecemos:
• Incorporación a un equipo altamente cualificado, con proyecto estable.
• Salario negociable en función de experiencia / conocimientos aportados.
• Modalidad de trabajo 100% remoto con asistencia puntual a nuestras oficinas de Madrid.
• Acceso a paquete de retribución flexible.
• Acceso a planes de formación.

Requisitos

Inglés intermedio-alto B2

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola! ¿Ya nos hemos presentado? Somos Eurofirms Group, una empresa de Recursos Humanos en la que los humanos somos muchísimo más que recursos. Somos la 1ª empresa nacional del sector y llevamos más de 30 años trabajando con un mismo propósito: mejorar la vida de las personas creando un entorno en el que poder brillar.

En Eurofirms Group creemos en el talento único de cada persona y sabemos que la diversidad aporta valor a los equipos, impulsando organizaciones más innovadoras, creativas y eficientes. Por eso, de acuerdo con nuestra cultura People first, trabajamos para generar entornos laborales inclusivos en los que cada individuo pueda crecer y desarrollar su mejor versión. Asimismo, buscamos actuar como agentes de cambio para promover la igualdad de oportunidades en nuestro entorno, fomentando el respeto y apostando por la diversidad en todas sus formas.

Seas como seas y sientas como sientas, en Eurofirms Group tendrás un sitio para brillar.

¿Deseas unirte a una empresa que... crece y evoluciona constantemente? En Eurofirms seleccionamos a Data Analyst para formar parte del área IT en nuestra oficina de Madrid.

¿Qué harás?

Tu misión principal será la de habilitar la toma de decisiones de negocio informadas mediante datos e información.

Entre tus funciones, te ocuparás de las siguientes tareas:
• Diseñar una solución basada en datos a las preguntas de negocio planteadas.
• Trabajar con el resto del equipo de datos (Data Engineers y Data Scientists) para implementar las soluciones propuestas.
• Elaborar informes y cuadros de mando mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence, destinados a las demás funciones de negocio que consuman la información.
• Realizar extracciones de datos a medida que responden a necesidades puntuales de información.

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

Buscamos una persona con una buena comunicación y buena capacidad de escucha, con atención al detalle y orientado al servicio. Alguien proactivo y autónomo.

Aptitudes necesarias:
• Interlocución con diversos niveles organizativos y diversas áreas funcionales.
• Capacidad de traducir del lenguaje de negocio al técnico y viceversa.
• Pensamiento estratégico y orientado a sistemas.
• Interpretar y asimilar información fragmentada.
• Construir historias relevantes a partir de la información contenida en los datos.

Requisitos:
• Herramientas y conceptos de Business Intelligence (Microsoft, Tableau, QlikSense o similares)
• Herramientas de scripting en herramientas de Business Intelligence (SSAS, DAX, Qlik scripting…)
• Conocimientos de visualización de datos y visual storytelling (Power BI, Informes SSRS o similares)
• Conceptos de modelado de datos e información
• Bases de datos y SQL
• Hojas de cálculo y tablas dinámicas (Excel)

Se valorará:
• Aportar experiencia en herramientas de ETL (SSIS, Power Query, Talend, Informatica Power Center, …)
• Tener conocimientos adicionales de programación.
• Idioma inglés.

¿Qué ventajas tiene trabajar en una empresa People first?

En Eurofirms Group te ofrecemos el mejor entorno y condiciones para que puedas brillar tanto en tu vida profesional como en la personal.

Un trabajo que hace de la conciliación una realidad:
• Dos jornadas de teletrabajo a la semana.
• Tarde libre semanal.
• Retribución flexible para ahorrar en tus gastos de manutención, transporte, guardería o seguro médico a través de Cobee.

Tu salud, y la de los tuyos, es lo primero:
• Mutua de salud gratuita y con descuentos para tu familia, a partir de los 2 años en Eurofirms
• Descuento del 50% en la cuota de múltiples gimnasios disponibles en la app AndJoy.

A tu lado en los momentos especiales:
• Día libre el día de tu cumpleaños.

Si te apasiona el mundo de la innovación y la tecnología, esta es tu oportunidad para crecer en la primera empresa nacional de recursos humanos. ¡Únete a nuestro equipo EurofirmsIT

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs_results.description:
This internship would suit a student looking for work alongside their studies as part of their degree (internship credit required!).

This role welcomes both full remote and hybrid work arrangements. However, applicants must be based in Spain, France, UK, or Italy.

ABOUT LAUNCHMETRICS

Launchmetrics provides the First AI-powered Brand Performance Cloud for Fashion, Luxury and Beauty (FLB) companies to make smarter decisions around their brand marketing efforts.

Our suite of SaaS leverages AI and data to help our customers plan, execute and measure brand marketing initiatives. With over a decade of industry expertise, we have helped more than 1,200 customers create inspiring, impactful and measurable experiences.

Founded in NYC and with operating headquarters in Paris, we have employees in ten markets worldwide. We have been the trusted brand performance technology to brands worldwide such as Dior, Fendi, Shiseido, NET-A-PORTER and Adidas as well as industry partners like IMG, the... Council of Fashion Designers of America, the British Fashion Council, and Camera Nazionale Della Moda Italiana.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Launchmetrics, data is the backbone of our products and the core of the value we deliver to our customers. Given data is a key asset for the company, data management is a top priority: it has a tremendous impact on the work of the different teams and creates new opportunities for products to bring value to our customers!

While you will bring immediate value by applying your data analytics skills, there is an opportunity to learn elements of the data engineering discipline, where you can have a bigger impact on data architecture and generation upstream.
Our vision of ATLAS 🌟

ATLAS is our Data Lake, powered by DataBricks. It serves as the central repository for storing, managing, and analyzing huge volumes of data within our organization. This data lake is designed to empower data-driven decision-making, enhance collaboration, and drive innovation across all departments.

As a Data Analyst Intern, your role will be to enhance the functionality and utilization of Atlas by:
• Assisting in the management of Atlas Support Tickets: Act as a first point of contact for help tickets related to our Data Lake, ensuring swift and efficient resolution of queries and issues.
• Providing support on the Atlas Support Slack Channel, provide assistance and guidance to other engineers on coding questions and Databricks best practices, and fostering a collaborative environment.
• Conducting ad hoc data investigations, unearthing insights to drive business strategies and decisions.
• Troubleshooting data inconsistencies, ensuring the reliability and accuracy of our data.
• Crafting presentation slides, translating complex data findings into digestible and compelling narratives for non-tech teams.
• Developing and maintaining BI dashboards, creating visual representations that drive insights and actions.
• Documenting our data assets and dashboards, enhancing data discovery inside our data catalog.

ABOUT YOUSkills and Qualifications:
• Academic Background: You are currently pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and you have some demonstrable practical experience in data analytics.
• Curiosity and Enthusiasm: You have a passion for data analytics and technology, coupled with a proactive attitude towards learning and problem-solving.
• Technical Skills: You are familiar with Metabase or similar BI tools, basic understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases, and interest in DataLake.
• Analytical Abilities: You have strong capability to analyze data, identify patterns, and derive meaningful insights to support business decisions.
• Communication: You are able to simplify complex data concepts for various audiences.
• Problem-Solving: You demonstrate efficiency in troubleshooting and resolving issues, demonstrating quick thinking and adaptability.
• Collaborative Spirit: You work effectively within a team, leveraging collaboration to meet collective goals.
• Continuous Learning: You demonstrate commitment to staying informed on the latest in data analytics technologies and practices.
• Fluency in English: You must be fluent in English, both written and verbal, to ensure effective communication across our global team.
Extra-Credit:
• Coding Proficiency: You have experience with Python or R for data manipulation and ETL processes.
• Data Documentation: You are willing to apply data documentation and governance practices.
• Experience with Product Analytics: You are familiarwith product analytics tools, understanding the dynamics of product interaction and user experience.
• Social Media Monitoring: Skills in leveraging social media analytics, to track brand mentions, and trends, providing valuable insights into consumer behavior.
• Passion for FLB Industries: You are interested in Fashion, Lifestyle, and Beauty sectors, wishing to apply data analytics within these industries.

We value diverse perspectives and recognize that skills and experiences can be gained in various ways. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every single requirement listed, we would love to hear from you and encourage you to submit an application!

RECRUITING PROCESS 🤝

#1: Intro Call - Juliette Le Guennec, PeopleOps Manager

#2: Meet & Greet w/ hiring manager - Suril Vara, Technical Project Manager

#3: Skills Assessment - Suril Vara, Technical Project Manager & Andrea Sozzo, Data Product Director

Our Commitment: Launchmetrics is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. Link the EEO. If there is anything extra we can do to help you feel at ease during your interview process, please let the PeopleOps team member you’ll be meeting with know

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst & Marketing Intelligence Manager
jobs_results.description:
¡Súmate a la 4ª revolución tecnológica!

En Global Alumni, la primera EdTech euroamericana, hemos conseguido derribar las fronteras físicas y del idioma, acercando el conocimiento y el prestigio de las mejores universidades y escuelas de negocios del mundo a cualquier profesional en un entorno digital, globalizado y en continuo cambio.

Ofrecemos a las universidades la gestión integral de sus programas de posgrado en modalidad online y semipresencial. Nos encargamos del diseño y el lanzamiento de las campañas de marketing, la elaboración del contenido digital de los programas formativos y la gestión académica. Todo ello en seis idiomas y en un entorno multicultural.

Global Alumni está en plena expansión. Como parte de este crecimiento, buscamos un Data Analyst & Marketing Intelligence Manager.

Responsabilidades:
• Dirigir y gestionar el equipo de análisis de datos (área marketing y ventas) para impulsar la generación de ideas y la ejecución de estrategias efectivas.
• Desarrollar e... implementar estrategias de recopilación, análisis y visualización de datos para informar las decisiones de marketing.
• Crear y mantener dashboards y reportes personalizados para monitorizar KPIs clave.
• Utilizar herramientas avanzadas de análisis de datos y machine learning para identificar insights y oportunidades de optimización en las campañas de marketing.
• Desarrollar modelos predictivos y realizar análisis predictivos para respaldar iniciativas comerciales.
• Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de marketing para definir objetivos, KPIs y métricas de éxito para las campañas.
• Realizar análisis de mercado y competencia para informar las estrategias de posicionamiento y diferenciación de la marca.
• Monitorizar el rendimiento de las campañas de marketing y proporcionar informes periódicos con recomendaciones para la mejora continua.

DATA ANALYST

Contract type: Indefinite

Working day: Full time

Location: Spain / Marroco

Who is ATREBO?

Atrebo is a Spanish technology company with more than 10 years of experience in the sector, specialised in projects of digitalisation of operations at a global level. We have offices in Sao Paulo, Seville, Madrid and Oslo.

Atrebo develops TREE, a specialised platform for digital transformation in asset and infrastructure management in telecommunications, energy, smart cities and other industries, as well as Big Data, cloud, projects, etc. It leads the Tower Automation Alliance initiative through an ecosystem of technology partners around the world.

We offer companies end-to-end management of their operational processes. Through automation, we enable the lifecycle of all our customers' business processes to achieve the best performance until they are converted into business intelligence data. We guide them on their journey towards digital transformation.

Who are we looking for... at ATREBO?

We are looking for a profile with experience in Power BI for data analysis. Python programming experience is a plus.

You will be part of the company's development team, where you will have the opportunity to work on different projects and services worldwide.

Responsabilities:
• Deep data analysis from different datasources/systems.
• Report and Dashboard implementation with Power BI.
• Creation and management of data models.
• Identification and implementation of process improvement opportunities.
• Python development for data analysis.
• Code optimisation for performance improvement.
• Big Data management.
• Updating and managing Azure SQL Server databases.
• Identification and implementation of automation/automation opportunities.
• Implementation of predictive/intelligent algorithms.

Job requirements:
• Experience with data analytics (small and big data), with Power BI knowledge and experience.
• Experience with SQL databases.
• Experience in cloud environments (MS Azure desirable).
• Python programming. Pandas libraries and spark.
• Customer communication skills
• Fluent in English

Positively valued:
• Knowledge in other visualization platforms: Grafana, Superset.
• Knowledge in automation, ML, data analytics and AI.

Competencies
• Time management.
• Adaptability to change.
• Proactive.
• Initiative.
• Team player.
• Good communication skills.
• Commitment and attention to detail.
• Continuous learning.
• Ability to develop multidisciplinary projects.
• Technical leadership.

Languages
• C1 English
• Spanish

Benefits of working with ATREBO

We offer a flexible and 100% remote schedule.

Excellent working environment with agile methodology.

Training and possibility of real growth.

Work on high-profile, high-impact projects.

Contact with important global clients.

A technological challenge for you, where you will work and learn in a very powerful team

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Join Our Team as a Senior Data Analyst and Revolutionise Shared Electric Mobility!

At YEGO, we're on a mission to transform urban mobility through our innovative electric vehicle-sharing service. Since our launch in 2016, we've expanded our operations across numerous cities in Spain and France, offering our riders an eco-friendly, stylish, and efficient way to navigate urban environments. We're dedicated to enhancing city life and reducing environmental impact, one ride at a time. To continue our growth and enhance our data-driven decisions, we're looking for a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our team.

Mission

As a Data Analyst, you will support and empower Yego´s departments with key data that will allow them to make strategic decisions and improve business performance.

Reporting to the Head of Data, this role is embedded in the day-to-day business performance and holds the reporting responsibilities for Yego.

The Data Analyst will be a key partner for... Operations and Marketing departments providing and analysing performance trends, user acquisition, retention rates, rides forecast, operations performance, etc.

Responsibilities
• Business KPIs reporting
• Product Analytics, tracking and reporting on the product features and improvements
• Maintaining and improving the reporting and visualization outcomes
• Identify, analyze and interpret trends and anomalies in the data for different departments, communicate findings
• Provide insight, guidance, and recommendations to Operations and Marketing by interpreting and analyzing the business data
• Discovering and exploring datasets and proposing new tracking to improve data sources and decisions
• Forecasting and setting targets at the department/function level to reach objectives as well as working with the teams to see business cases for uplifts in the KPIs results

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Data, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related fields
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in relevant roles
• Proficiency in statistical methods and data analysis techniques for quantitative and qualitative data
• Proficiency in Python and its data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
• Expertise in statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and algorithm development.
• Strong experience with SQL (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and ETL processes
• Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Perks
• Join the ride to revolutionize shared-mobility in style 🎉
• Rub shoulders with a young, passionate crew chasing the same dreams 👫Chill in our modern Poblenou headquarters 🏠
• Free fruit, snacks, coffee and tea at the office.
• Private Health Insurance (Cigna) 🏥
• Gym membership discounts (AndJoy) 🏋️
• Unlimited use of Yego vehicles 🛵
• Flexible retribution plan (Cobee).
• Flexible working hours and remote working conditions.

At YEGO, we believe in making cities more livable through sustainable mobility solutions. We'd love to hear from you if you share our passion and have the skills we're looking for. Help us drive the future of urban transport as our new Senior Data Analyst!

YEGO is proud of being an equal-opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of background, gender, religion, orientation, age, or ability. Come as you are; we've got a spot just for you. 🌈

jobs_results.description:
Nuestro cliente es una importante multinacional española, con los HQ en el Alt Empordà. Se encuentra en pleno inicio del proceso de transformación digital y por ello, queremos reforzar la estructura con un/a Analista Data / BI.

Queremos que nos ayudes a crear la plataforma analítica de de la cmpañía para los próximos años, aportando las siguientes funciones en equipo:
• Creación de la plataforma data y analítica de la compañía en tecnología Azure (requisito no imprescindible), conectando las diferentes fuentes de datos y aplicaciones de negocio y creando procesos de ingesta y profiling de datos con calidad y robustez.
• Trabajando de forma conjunta con las diferentes áreas de negocio e iniciativas priorizadas por dirección, crear y mantener los KPI’s y métricas de toda la compañía, con las dimensiones correspondientes.
• Participar en los proyectos transversales de la compañía donde la analítica o reporting de datos sea necesaria, y liderar las iniciativas locales o regionales que se... definan.
• Coordinar tanto a los usuarios internos como a proveedores externos de servicio.
• Aportar el gobierno y metodología de toda el área de data en cuanto a unicidad, seguridad, testeo, calidad de dato, y catálogo de métricas.

OFRECEMOS:
• Incorporación inmediata, indefinida y totalmente estabe en compañía de primer nivel, que se está posicionando como líder en su sector.
• Papel protagonista en contacto directo con los principales miembros de la organización
• Salario negociable en función de cada candidato
• Proyecto totalmente estable
• Posibilidad de modelo híbrido de trabajo.

Requisitos:
• Gestión y modelado en base de datos SQL Server
• Modelado y gestión en arquitectura data Factory en Azure (Synapse, Data factory, Onelake,..)
• Gestión y modelado de ingesta, ETL, QA de datos en entorno Azure.
• Análisis y modelado de métricas, KPI’s en entorno empresarial.
• Modelado de reporting en PowerBI y/o Qlik Sense.
• Soporte a usuarios
